records.title: COMPARATIVE TEXTS
pages:
THE OLDER ACCOUNTS DESCRIBE
WHEELS WITHIN WHEELS,

AND MOVEMENT IN FOUR
DIRECTIONS WITHOUT TURNING.

RING CHAMBER 3 MATCHES.
RING CHAMBER 3 PREDATES
THE ACCOUNTS.

records.title: ON THE NUMBER
pages:
THE OLDER ACCOUNTS ALSO
COUNT TO SEVEN.

WE HAVE NOT DECIDED
WHICH CAME FIRST.

records.title: THE EMPTY PLACE
pages:
AN OLDER ACCOUNT DESCRIBES
A PLACE WHERE THE HOSTS
WERE KEPT,

AND A FIRE THAT EXTENDED
BEYOND SEEING,

WE HAVE BEEN THERE.
THERE WAS NO FIRE.

records.title: ON THE WATCHERS
pages:
THE ACCOUNTS SAY THEY WERE
SET TO WATCH.

THE ACCOUNTS DO NOT SAY
WHAT THEY WERE SET TO WATCH.

WE HAVE STOPPED GUESSING.

records.title: EDITORIAL NOTE
pages:
THIS IS NOT A CLAIM ABOUT
ANYONE'S FAITH.

IT IS A CLAIM THAT PEOPLE
STOOD WHERE WE ARE STANDING
AND HAD NO WORDS FOR IT.
